name: mechframe
description: MechFrame's web workspaces: the kernel's web half, each module's web binding and the harness app.
//: overrides.minimatch: eslint 10 and typescript-eslint 8 ask for minimatch 10, which has GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (dev-only, a DoS). 11.0.8 is past it; drop the override when they move to 11.

overrides.openapi-typescript: 7.13 asks for TypeScript ^5 as a peer; the repo is on 6.0.x for typescript-eslint, and the generator runs fine on it (npm run api:check passes). Drop the override when it allows 6.

engines.node: what every locked package accepts, jsdom 31 the narrowest (^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0; ESLint 10 wants ^22.13, @axe-core/playwright 4.14 22.12: CodeRabbit on #92); engine-strict is on (.npmrc).
overrides.@axe-core/playwright: it asks for playwright-core ^1 and would pull a newer one than the runner's; held to @playwright/test's own, so one Chromium build (1248) serves both.
